verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a marketing claim that every AI agent has an audit trail, managed from the same console that governs human users. That suggests some admin-level audit capability, but it does not document a workspace-wide audit log of human and agent actions that an admin can review. Missing for 10: documentation of a workspace-wide admin audit log covering all user actions, details on how to review, filter or export it, an audit log API, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
